reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 32. Nay or No: 8. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 37 (92%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
I’m immensely pleased that @Jim_Jordan was selected by our Conference as the next Minority Leader.

Congratulations, my friend!

Election integrity is not a mere suggestion – it is the keystone of free and fair elections that have always guided the course of our nation throughout history. The counting process for the 5th District election has not halted. The count is ongoing in accordance with North Carolina state law. The continuing process, our laws, and faithful election administration will determine the election in the 5th District – and nothing else.  
 
At my request, nonpartisan election observers under the guidance of the Committee on House Administration will be present across the 5th District as the count continues, and will serve as important, watchful eyes to ensure that this sacred process is not impeded and that all legal votes are counted in a consistent, thorough manner.
 
These observers are dispatched in accordance with the Confirmation of Congressional Observer Access Act for the purpose of observing all parts of the election process including voting, ballot processing, and ballot tabulation. Additionally, they are responsible for gathering information as they monitor the election process.
 
My work in service to the constituents of the 5th District remains ongoing, and my offices continue to stand at the ready to assist. The process will continue.

Socialism should die on the vine.

It has no place in America 🇺🇸

For Epstein’s victims, accountability will prevail. My latest op-ed in the Greensboro News & Record:

https://t.co/a6PLkpMLed

Today, I reintroduced the Disaster Recovery and Resilience Act, legislation that would implement comprehensive regulatory reform designed to aid areas impacted by natural disasters.

This legislation ensures that North Carolinians will never again have to bear the brunt of exhaustive, crippling red tape and regulatory burdens to simply rebuild what is ours.

https://t.co/DfWiniijvI

The House just passed my bipartisan bill, the Protect Economic and Academic Freedom Act, that takes a strong stand against the BDS movement on college campuses across the nation. 

Thank you, @RepJoshG, for your partnership in helping lead this legislation alongside me.

This legislation has true teeth and completely severs any possible taxpayer support of these concrete campaigns of antisemitism in the form of BDS and academic boycotts of Israel. 

The Senate should take it up immediately!

A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
